title: Theophysics Blue Sheet: The Fair Comparison Standard

canonical_node.axiom: Theophysics is the fair-comparison claim that Christian reality may explain the shared world with fewer hidden assumptions than closed naturalism, while preserving more of what humans and science both have to treat as real.
definitions: Fair comparison: same observations, same standards, no hidden upgrades, no hidden subsidies.
Hidden upgrade: an illicit move that upgrades theology into physics or analogy into isomorphism without warrant.
Hidden subsidy: an unacknowledged assumption or cost that a framework relies on without counting it.
Closed Naturalism: the view that reality is ultimately impersonal and that mind, morality, meaning, etc. must be explained from below.
Theophysics: the view that reality is ultimately grounded in God, with physics and theology as distinct registers, and the bridge tested, not assumed.
derivation: Every worldview must explain the same set of observations (existence, distinction, lawfulness, information, measurement, consciousness, moral obligation, beauty, evil, guilt, love, sacrifice, repair, hope).
Both frameworks are judged by the same standards: coherence, explanatory power, assumption cost, register honesty, predictive/retrodictive reach, failure visibility, human fit.
Theophysics must not claim hidden upgrades (e.g., physics proves God, every analogy is isomorphism).
Naturalism must not claim hidden subsidies (e.g., truth assumed without cost, consciousness reducible when convenient).
Theophysics proposes that many postulates may be projections of a deeper triadic ground, but this is not yet proved.
The burden is to show shared structure, reduced assumption cost, and unique grounding in a triune God without collapsing into monism, dualism, or arbitrary pluralism.
Therefore, the fair test is: same observations, same standards, no hidden upgrades, no hidden subsidies.
canonical_node.action: Apply the fair comparison standard to any competing explanatory framework, requiring both sides to account for the same observations under the same standards, and to disclose all assumptions and costs without hidden upgrades or subsidies.
boundary: Does not claim that physics proves God or that any analogy is an isomorphism.
Does not claim that every emotional resonance is evidence or that every mathematical model is a theorem.
Does not assert that Theophysics has already met its burden; it only defines the standard and the research program.
Does not require naturalism to be false; it only requires that both sides be judged fairly.
test: Check that both frameworks are presented with the same set of observations.
Check that the same standards are applied to both sides.
Check that no hidden upgrades are used by Theophysics (e.g., no claim that physics proves God).
Check that no hidden subsidies are used by naturalism (e.g., truth assumed without cost).
Check that the burden is stated as a requirement to show shared structure, reduced assumption cost, and unique grounding, not as already fulfilled.

dg1_dependencies: None explicit; this is an opening blue sheet defining a standard.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Defines a fair comparison standard and a research program for Theophysics, without claiming proof.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the requirement that Theophysics must not make hidden upgrades and must be tested by the same standards as naturalism.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this standard, Theophysics could be accused of special pleading or hidden upgrades; the fair comparison is the foundational doorway.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Adopt as a methodological guardrail for all Theophysics comparisons; do not treat as a proof of Theophysics.

overstatement_risks: Could be misread as claiming that Theophysics already explains more with fewer assumptions.
Could be misread as requiring naturalism to be false.
Could be misread as a proof of the triune grounding.
kill_conditions: If Theophysics makes a hidden upgrade (e.g., claims physics proves God), the standard is violated.
If naturalism is not given the same observations or standards, the comparison is unfair.
If the burden is not met (shared structure, reduced assumption cost, unique grounding), the claim fails.
risk.lean_target: A formalized comparison protocol that can be applied to specific Theophysics claims.

plain_summary: This document sets the ground rule for Theophysics: it must be compared fairly with naturalism, using the same observations and standards, without hidden upgrades or subsidies. It does not claim proof; it defines the burden and the test.
